% References to labels of another document with xr, from an .aux that
% LaTeX wrote under hyperref: five fields per label, and no .xref beside
% it. Each prints its number, page, or name as in the PDF, in each
% context. A label in an .aux that tex4ht wrote without hyperref, with
% its .xref, still links to that document's page.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{amsthm}
\usepackage{hyperref}
\usepackage{xr}
\externaldocument[X-]{test-xr/latex}
\externaldocument[T-]{test-xr/tex4ht}
\newtheorem{theorem}{Theorem}
\begin{document}
\section{Another document}
Starred \ref*{X-s}. Section \ref{X-ss}. Page \pageref{X-front}.
Item \ref{X-item}. Bold \ref{X-emph}. Empty [\ref{X-none}].
Named \nameref{X-thm}. Named in italics \nameref{X-emph}.

\textit{In italics, \ref{X-ss}.}
A note.\footnote{In a footnote, \ref{X-ss}.}
\textsf{In sans-serif, \ref{X-ss}.}
\texttt{In typewriter, \ref{X-ss}.}

\begin{theorem}
In a theorem, \ref{X-ss}.
\end{theorem}

\subsection{Heading \ref*{X-ss}}
Written by tex4ht: \ref{T-oss}.
\end{document}
